prompt: Ink and watercolor illustration in the style of a fantasy cartographer's sketchbook: thick uneven black India-ink outlines with a dip-pen look, loose wet-in-wet indigo and deep teal washes, granulating pigment, warm ochre touches only for lit windows and lanterns, visible paper grain, wide cinematic panoramic landscape at night. No people, no text, no frame. The bottom fifth is a dark, empty, rocky shore foreground with a few tide pools, with no buildings or figures on it. Thick pale mist lies on a black sea between rocky islands, curling into whispering spirals like voices; out of the mist a small lantern-lit fishing boat, and far away on an island a tiny stone fortress with a few warm lit windows. Cold teal and indigo palette, faint pale moon behind the mist. Avoid: text, letters, captions, signature, watermark, frame, border, photorealism, 3D render, glossy digital painting, saturated colors, neon, anime style, gore
